title: Michael Eisner rejects the plasma fireworks

tellings.quote:
fact, when Michael Eisner, the CEO of
Disney, I first showed him these things.
He said, "Oh, we're not going to do
this.

plain: Eric Haseltine once showed Michael Eisner, then the head of Disney, a kind of plasma fireworks, and Eisner turned it down on the spot: "Oh, we're not going to do this." Haseltine, who worked at Walt Disney Imagineering, Disney's design and engineering arm, and later became a senior official at the NSA, tells Michels about it as something he was there for.
